chunks: And by this chain, he said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The most evil servant is the filthy/obscene one.

key_terms.القاذورة: The filthy/obscene one — encompasses physical dirt, foul speech, and moral degradation; a comprehensive term for one who neglects cleanliness and propriety
key_terms.بئس: A Quranic formula of condemnation: 'how evil is...' — the strongest expression of dispraise in Arabic rhetoric

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about filthy or obscene servants in Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) condemned in the strongest terms the person who is filthy or obscene — whether in bodily cleanliness, speech, or conduct. The term al-qadhura encompasses physical filth, moral impurity, and obscene behavior. This hadith appears in a chapter on beautification and displaying God's bounties, contextualizing cleanliness as a religious and social obligation in early Shia teaching.

en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
(Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
The most evil servant is the filthy one’.
en.sarwar: 6. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “He (the Imam )’ Alayhi al-Salam has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
The worse servant is a dirty servant.’”
